subject: MAP & eval exchange — acceptance gates, custody, and usage constraints
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@retailco.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: RetailCo Legal <contracts@retailco.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP request — evaluation dataset provisioning

Hi Mina / Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week. As discussed, we want to move to a short MAP so we can get the evaluation dataset, prompt pack, and a small suite of test cases into our staging sandbox. Key asks from our side:

- Delivery timeline with acceptance gates (QA pass, ML metric tolerance, sample approval).
- Clear usage constraints (no production ingress, ephemeral access, non-retention of derived data).
- Custody and deletion schedule for the dataset and logs.
- Legal redlines: minimal retention, audit trail, and certification of destruction.

Can you share a proposed MAP and the prompt pack so our legal and infra teams can review? We aim to complete procurement and close the MAP within two weeks if the terms are reasonable.

Attaching the initial buyer checklist from our side (see referenced attachments).

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Data Products — RetailCo
samir@retailco.com

[attachment: RetailCo_MPA_Checklist.pdf]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@retailco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & eval exchange — acceptance gates, custody, and usage constraints

Samir — thanks, this is clear and reasonable. Attaching a brief MAP draft (MAP_RetailCo_v1.pdf) and the prompt pack bundle (RetailCo_PROMPTPACK_v1.zip). High-level plan below:

1) Week 0 (Mon–Wed): Redwood delivers prompt pack + evaluation dataset snapshot (ephemeral staging access).
2) Week 1: RetailCo runs acceptance tests; we provide a small set of canonical outputs and metric baselines.
3) Acceptance gates:
   - Functional: 95% pass on the prioritized test cases (see testcases/*.csv in the prompt pack).
   - Quality: no regressions > 5% in RetailCo-specific F1/ROUGE thresholds from baseline.
   - Security: sandboxed VPC access, IP allowlist, and read-only download policy.
4) Custody: dataset will be available in a time-limited S3 bucket with MFA-delete disabled for the staging window; Redwood will revoke access and provide a signed deletion manifest within 7 days of acceptance/rejection.

Legal notes in the attached SOW_redlines_RetailCo.docx are intentionally conservative — Vanessa will coordinate with your contracts team to iterate.

Next steps:
- Samir: confirm the acceptance metric owners and which testcases are blockers for go/no-go.
- RetailCo Legal: we can start with the redlines; I’ll add DocuSign-ready pages once we agree scope.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

[attachments: MAP_RetailCo_v1.pdf, RetailCo_PROMPTPACK_v1.zip, SOW_redlines_RetailCo.docx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@retailco.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & eval exchange — acceptance gates, custody, and usage constraints

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 11:02 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Mina: attaching MAP + prompt pack

Thanks — a few technical clarifications from infra/ops so RetailCo's engineers can validate quickly:

- The dataset snapshot is a curated sample (<= 10k rows) and will be pre-tokenized; we include meta fields that indicate source and redaction status.
- Access model: temporary IAM role with session TTL = 72h and enforced client IP allowlist; no outbound network to RetailCo's production VPC.
- KV cache/response logs: Redwood will provide logs limited to request IDs and timing; we will not provide raw prompt ingestion logs unless explicitly requested and covered by an NDA addendum.
- Quantization/serving variant: we will serve the evaluation on our standard float16 path; if you need a quantized snapshot for cost parity, we can provide one but metrics may differ.

Blocking asks for the acceptance window: which three test cases are considered MUST-PASS? We can prioritize instrumenting those.

— Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@retailco.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & eval exchange — acceptance gates, custody, and usage constraints

Thanks team — quick update and concrete timeline so we can close: 

- RetailCo to confirm MUST-PASS testcases by end of day Thu, Nov 5.
- Redwood will provision ephemeral staging access and upload the dataset snapshot on Mon, Nov 8 (72h access token to start).
- Acceptance review window: Nov 9–11. If gates are met, Redwood will issue the signed deletion manifest and start SOW execution the week of Nov 15.

I’ve uploaded the MAP draft to the shared drive (link below) and opened a HubSpot deal record with the proposed close date of Nov 16. RetailCo Legal — please flag any fatal redlines; otherwise we’ll produce a DocuSign bundle by Nov 6.

DocuSign (draft): https://www.docusign.com/retailco-rdw-draft-example
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleDriveLink

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

> On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 2:28 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Blocking asks for the acceptance window: which three test cases are considered MUST-PASS?
>
Samir — if you can reply with the three MUST-PASS ids we’ll lock instrumentation and a test harness for automated runs. If there are no legal hold items, Vanessa will send the DocuSign link on Nov 6 and we’ll treat the MAP timeline above as the canonical close plan.

Thanks all.
